id.label: Provider name
id.help: Used to refer to this provider in models and routes. Letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens only.

enabled.label: Enable provider
enabled.help: Allow calls to the enabled models under this provider.

protocol.label: API protocol
protocol.help: systemone is for decision models such as TypeSafe Jev. They only classify and don't generate text, so they can only be used to split Work and Chat, triage proactive events, and route memory. To set one up: name it typesafe, choose the systemone protocol, set the Base URL to https://api.typesafe.ai/v1, and enter your TypeSafe key. Use jev-1.14.0 as the model name, then add it to the router / light / memory / approval routes. If your network can't reach TypeSafe, give this provider a proxy (for example http://127.0.0.1:7890).

base_url.help: The API prefix. OpenAI and Anthropic usually end in /v1, and Gemini in /v1beta. TypeSafe Jev is https://api.typesafe.ai/v1, and Jev through OpenRouter is https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

max_retries.label: Max retries
max_retries.help: Extra attempts after a timeout, rate limit, or temporary server error. 0 means no retries. The default of 2 sends at most 3 requests.

proxy.label: Network proxy
proxy.help: HTTP, HTTPS, or SOCKS5. Used for model discovery, tests, and real calls. Leave empty to use the service process's default network.

currency.label: Currency
currency.help: Used to estimate spending on the overview. Fetch prices from the provider below, or enter them from the provider's website.

price_input.label: Input price (per million tokens)
price_input.help: If all three prices are 0, pricing is treated as unset and the overview doesn't estimate spending.

price_cached.label: Cached input price (per million tokens)
price_cached.help: 0 means cached tokens are charged at the input price.

max_output.label: Max output tokens
max_output.help: The most tokens one reply can generate. Chat models commonly use 4096–8192. Too large can cut off long replies; too small can't finish them. Start with 4096.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: Allow routes to send requests to this model.

max_context.label: Max context tokens
max_context.help: Input plus output; must be larger than max output. 0 means unspecified (recommended). Tokens are estimated from characters, and when a request is too long the next candidate model is tried. Long-context models such as DeepSeek can use 64000, ordinary models 128000, or just leave it at 0.

modalities.label: Supported inputs
modalities.help: Choose at least one. With Image selected, images received on QQ are sent to this model directly; otherwise they're described in text or replaced with an [image] placeholder, depending on the image description settings. Audio and video aren't supported yet.

extra_body.label: Custom request body (JSON)
extra_body.help: A JSON object in the API's native format; nested objects are merged recursively. Gemini example: {"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.7}}. Text models stream by default to collect performance metrics; set {"stream":false} to turn that off. The model, conversation, and tool definitions are provided by the system.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: Allow this model to generate memory vectors.

dims.label: Vector dimensions
dims.help: 0 uses the model's default size. Models that support smaller vectors (such as OpenAI text-embedding-3 and Gemini) can use a smaller value. Changing this recomputes every memory vector.

extra_body.label: Custom request body (JSON)
extra_body.help: For OpenAI-compatible APIs, merged into the /embeddings request body in its native format. Not used by Gemini APIs.

enabled.label: Enable connection
enabled.help: After saving, connect to this protocol client to receive messages and send replies.

url.label: WebSocket URL
url.help: NapCat's Universal WebSocket address. Only ws:// and wss:// are supported.

owner_id.label: Owner QQ number
owner_id.help: The owner's private chat gets full Agent access. Everyone else, and all group chats, can only use Chat mode.

groups.label: Enabled groups
groups.help: One group number per line. Only groups on this list get replies.

friends.label: Enabled friends
friends.help: One QQ number per line. Friends other than the owner must be listed here to use Chat mode.

ignore_users.label: Ignored accounts
ignore_users.help: One QQ number per line. Takes priority over the allow lists.

auto_start.label: Auto-start protocol client
auto_start.help: Try to start the protocol client when its process disappears and connecting keeps failing. One argument per line, for example C:\Apps\NapCat\Shell\launcher.bat. Leave empty to turn this off. If the launcher needs administrator rights, a UAC prompt may appear, or the start may fail when no one is around (this is logged).

auto_start_after.label: Start after failing for (seconds)
auto_start_after.help: Avoids starting the client during a brief reconnect. Automatic starts are at least 5 minutes apart.

app_id.help: The numeric App ID from the QQ Open Platform.

app_secret.placeholder: Saved · leave empty to keep it

owner_id.label: Owner OpenID
owner_id.help: Your one-on-one chat OpenID under this App.
owner_id.help2: In private chats, the Feishu bot only replies to the owner, who can use Agent tools.

groups.label: Allowed group OpenIDs
groups.help: One group chat ID per item, starting with oc_.

memory_profile.label: Memory store
memory_profile.help: Used for the owner's private Feishu chat.

wake_keywords.label: Group wake words
wake_keywords.help: The bot replies when a message starts with any of these words.

feishu_group_context.label: Record Feishu group context
feishu_group_context.help: When on, replies take the group's recent messages into account.

enabled.label: Enable instance
enabled.help: Allow the assistant to hand tasks to this subagent.

command.label: Start command
command.help: The executable on the first line (such as codex, claude, dsh, or agy), then one argument per line.

proxy.label: Network proxy
proxy.help: Applies to this instance only. Leave empty to inherit the environment. HTTP, HTTPS, or SOCKS5; which protocols work depends on the CLI.

model.label: Model
model.help: Leave empty to use the CLI's default model.

add_dirs.label: Extra directories
add_dirs.help: One absolute path per line. Subagents only work inside their own task directory by default; list other directories they may access here.

sandbox.label: Sandbox mode
sandbox.help: Codex's sandbox_mode. Background runs never ask for approval, so anything outside the sandbox simply fails.

network_access.label: Allow network access
network_access.help: sandbox_workspace_write.network_access; only applies in writable workspace mode. Full access mode can always use the network.

add_dirs.help: One absolute path per line: extra writable directories in workspace-write mode (writable_roots).

permission_mode.label: Permission mode

options.dontAsk: Only tools on the allow list (dontAsk)

permission_mode.help: permissions.defaultMode. No one answers permission prompts in the background, so anything the mode or allow list doesn't permit is denied.

tools.label: Available tools
tools.help: One built-in tool name per line (such as Read, Edit, Bash). Leave empty for the CLI's default set.

allowed_tools.label: Allowed tools
allowed_tools.help: permissions.allow: used without asking. One per line, such as Bash, WebFetch, Bash(git *).

disallowed_tools.label: Blocked tools
disallowed_tools.help: permissions.deny: takes priority over the allow list. One per line, such as Bash(rm *).

permission_preset.label: Permission preset
permission_preset.help: --permission-mode: the name of a permission preset configured in dsh. Built in: workspace-write (only the workspace is writable) and danger-full-access (no sandbox). auto requires turning on Auto review in dsh first.

approval_policy.label: Approval policy
approval_policy.help: --approval-policy. Nobody answers in headless mode, so ask is also denied for lack of an answer; never tells the model up front not to ask for extra permissions.

add_dirs.help: One absolute path per line, passed as --add-dir: extra writable directories in workspace-write mode.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.help: The main agent sees this when choosing an instance, and the subagent follows it.

native_tools.label: Allowed tools
native_tools.help: Granted by tool name. Every call still has to pass the originating session's permission checks.

native_skills.label: Allowed Skills
native_skills.help: Selected Skills can be used through skill_list and skill_read. Any other tools a Skill needs must be selected separately.

native_manual_approval.label: Require manual approval for tool calls
native_manual_approval.help: When off, the originating session's approval policy applies.

shell_command.label: Shell start arguments
shell_command.help: One argument per line. Default: bash --noprofile --norc -c.

approval_allow_threshold.label: Jev approval threshold
approval_allow_threshold.help: Jev's approval probability must reach this value for the call to go ahead directly; otherwise it's handled as "not confident".

approval_deny_threshold.label: Jev denial threshold
approval_deny_threshold.help: Jev's denial probability must reach this value to count as a clear denial; otherwise it's treated as not confident.

options.fallback: Let a text model review it
Let a text model review it

dynamic_subagent.label: Allow dynamic built-in subagents
dynamic_subagent.help: When on, the main agent can create temporary built-in subagents with subagent_spawn. They inherit the current session's permissions and approval policy.

dynamic_subagent_model_override.label: Let dynamic subagents choose a model
dynamic_subagent_model_override.help: Allow the main agent to pick any enabled text model in subagent_spawn. When off, the Agent route is always used.

debounce_enabled.label: Merge consecutive messages
debounce_enabled.help: When on, consecutive messages from the same sender in a QQ private or group chat are handled as one turn.

debounce_seconds.label: Merge wait (seconds)
debounce_seconds.help: Consecutive messages from one sender within this time become one turn. 0 turns merging off.

debounce_max_seconds.label: Longest merge wait (seconds)
debounce_max_seconds.help: If new messages keep arriving, the turn waits at most this long.

debounce_suffixes.label: Endings that start right away
debounce_suffixes.help: One per line. A message ending with any of these doesn't wait. Leave empty to always wait the full time.

enabled.label: Enable the proactive engine
enabled.help: Handle external events, and contact the owner on its own, following Do Not Disturb and notification rules.

throttle_seconds.label: Gap between notifications from one source (seconds)

persona.label: Base persona
persona.help: Used when no named persona is selected. The full prompt can only be edited here; slash commands only show persona IDs and names.

concurrency.label: LLM concurrency
concurrency.help: Takes effect after restarting the process.

assistant_name.label: Assistant's name
assistant_name.help: Used in conversations, memory summaries, and context management.

wake_keywords.label: Wake words
wake_keywords.help: One per line. Used for QQ messages and Feishu private chats. Wake words for Feishu groups are set on the adapter.

wake_keyword_mode.label: Wake word matching
wake_keyword_mode.help: With start matching, the wake word must begin the message. The full message, wake word included, is passed to the model.

group_command_require_wake.label: Group / commands need waking
group_command_require_wake.help: By default, built-in and plugin / commands can be sent directly. When on, both need an @mention or a group wake word.

private_require_keyword.label: Private chats need a wake word
private_require_keyword.help: By default the bot answers private chats directly. When on, ordinary private messages on QQ and Feishu must contain a wake word above. Slash commands, stop, and approval replies always work.

help_menu_style.label: /help menu style
help_menu_style.help: The image groups commands into built-in and plugin sections, showing only commands available in the current session.

onebot_forward_long_messages.label: Fold long OneBot messages
onebot_forward_long_messages.help: In OneBot group and private chats, send long replies as one merged forward message. The protocol client must support merged forwards.

onebot_forward_threshold.label: Fold replies longer than (characters)
onebot_forward_threshold.help: With folding on, replies longer than this are folded.

id.label: Persona ID
id.help: Used to switch with /persona <ID>. Letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only; can't be default.

enabled.label: Enable persona
enabled.help: Allow this persona to be the default or to be switched to in a session.

prompt.label: Persona prompt
prompt.help: Only editable here. Command lists and switch replies never show the full prompt.

compression_tool_chars.label: Character limit per tool result in summaries
compression_tool_chars.help: Long results keep their beginning and end. 0 turns off truncation.

options.error: Show an error and keep compression progress

max_turns.label: Max turns kept in context
max_turns.help: Includes the turn about to start. Tool calls and steering messages in a turn count as part of it.

keep_recent_turns.label: Recent turns kept when compressing
keep_recent_turns.help: Less than the max turns. More old turns may be compressed if characters run short.

inject.label: Add relevant memories to each turn
inject.help: In the owner's private chat and the Proactive Loop, when a message mentions a known person or thing, or a search finds closely related memories, they're added to the end of the turn's message. Otherwise nothing is added.

inject_chars.label: Memory character budget
inject_chars.help: The most characters of memory added per turn. Memories already in the context aren't added again.

extract.label: Organize memories automatically
extract.help: The memory model extracts people, facts, and events from the owner's private chat and handled external events. Each needs evidence from the original text, and nothing the assistant itself said is remembered. When it isn't sure about a conflict, the agent asks you later in a conversation.

extract_messages.label: Organize after this many private messages

extract_idle_minutes.label: Organize after the private chat is idle for (minutes)
extract_idle_minutes.help: If the message count isn't reached, memories are also organized once the conversation has paused this long.

enabled.label: Enable group chat awareness
enabled.help: Record everything said in allowed groups, including messages that don't @ the bot. The latest 2000 messages are kept per group.

inject_messages.label: Messages added per turn
inject_messages.help: How many recent group messages come with a wake-up, not counting the triggering message. 0 adds none directly.

inject_chars.label: Character budget
inject_chars.help: The most characters of group history added. The newest messages are kept first, and this counts toward the context character limit.

query_tool.label: Provide the group_context_query tool
query_tool.help: Let the bot search the group's history by keyword or page back through it, and remind it in the prompt to do so when needed. Tool permissions still apply.

interject_mode.label: Joining group conversations
interject_mode.help: Works when group chat awareness is on. Simple mode samples group messages at random; Heartflow mode lets a light model decide when to join in. For OneBot 11 group chats.

interject_probability.label: Chance per group message
interject_probability.help: 0 never joins in; 1 may look at every message. Keep it very low, for example 0.02.

interject_cooldown.label: Cooldown (seconds)
interject_cooldown.help: The shortest gap between two looks in the same group.

interject_max_per_hour.label: Max per group per hour
interject_max_per_hour.help: Simple mode counts samples; Heartflow mode counts messages actually sent.

focus_seconds.label: Follow-up window (seconds)
focus_seconds.help: After the bot speaks, it pays extra attention to follow-up questions for this long. 0 turns this off.

max_streak.label: Max unprompted messages in a row

min_judge_interval.label: Shortest gap between looks while quiet (seconds)

caption.label: Describe images
caption.help: When the main model can't take images, an image description model turns each image into text once and caches it. When off, or with no description model configured, images become an [image] placeholder.

max_images.label: Max images sent directly per request
max_images.help: Models that accept images only get this many of the most recent images in the context. Older ones are described or replaced with a placeholder, so the same images aren't sent every turn.

enabled.label: Enable knowledge base tools
enabled.help: When on, search is available according to each session's bindings and tool permissions. Owner sessions can import and delete documents.

chat.label: Unbound Chat sessions can search the default library
chat.help: When on, unbound Chat private and group chats can search the default library. Sessions with an explicit binding search what they're bound to.

chunk_overlap.label: Chunk overlap (characters)
chunk_overlap.help: How much neighboring chunks repeat; at most half the chunk length. Tables are split by row without overlap.

max_file_mb.label: Max file size (MiB)
max_file_mb.help: Applies to WebUI uploads and files sent in private chats.

enabled.label: Enable the sticker manager
enabled.help: When on, sticker tools are available, and replies in QQ sessions can send stickers with <meme>category</meme>.

capacity.label: Sticker storage limit
capacity.help: Auto-collection and meme_save stop at the limit. Manual uploads in the WebUI aren't limited.

inject.label: Explain stickers to the model
inject.help: Describe the categories and markup at the end of the system prompt in QQ sessions. The text only changes with the settings, so it doesn't affect prompt caching.

collect.label: Collect from group chats
collect.help: When others post stickers in allowed groups, some are collected at random and added after description, persona, and category checks.

collect_rate.label: Base collection chance
collect_rate.help: Actual chance = base chance × (1 − stored / limit), so collection slows as the library fills up.

stickers_only.label: Only collect stickers
stickers_only.help: Only collect images QQ marks as stickers (animated or store stickers). When off, ordinary images can be collected too.

persona_check.label: Check persona fit before collecting
persona_check.help: The sticker route's decision model (or a text model if there isn't one) judges whether the default persona would send this sticker.

fit_threshold.label: Persona fit threshold
fit_threshold.help: Stickers that fit less than this aren't collected.

enabled.label: Enable emotion tracking
enabled.help: Pick up on how the user feels and how they're doing, and adjust the tone of replies. When off, no model is called and prompts don't change.

sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity.help: How small a signal updates the emotion score. Higher triggers more easily.

tone.label: Tone range
tone.help: How much emotion changes the tone. The highest setting allows a sincere word of care.

initiative.label: Initiative
initiative.help: How much replies reach out with care. Only at 0.8 or higher, and when the owner is doing badly, may the bot send a caring message on its own.

persistence.label: Persistence
persistence.help: How fast the score fades: at 0 it halves in about 6 hours, at 1 in about 7 days.

judge_weight.label: Judge model weight
judge_weight.help: The weight of the decision model's emotion score in the combined value. Ignored when no judge model is available.

rules_weight.label: Rule signal weight
rules_weight.help: The weight of local rules (being blocked, rushing, repetition, failure, describing difficulty) in the combined value.

sentiment_weight.label: Negative wording weight
sentiment_weight.help: The weight of negative wording. The three weights are normalized, so they don't need to add up to 1. If all are 0, the score stops updating.

developer.label: Developer log
developer.help: Write the judgments and current values to the log. The interface never shows the score, and message text isn't recorded.

createPersona.name: New persona
createPersona.prompt: You are a reliable personal assistant.

enabled.label: Enable web search
enabled.help: Once on, with a key for the chosen provider, the assistant can search the web.

max_results.label: Default number of results
max_results.help: The assistant can change this per search, up to 10 results.

hl.label: Search language
hl.help: Google language code, such as en or zh-cn.

gl.label: Search region
gl.help: Country or region code, such as us or cn.

need_content.label: Return page content
need_content.help: Fetch the source pages' text as well as titles and snippets.

localization.label: Localization IP
localization.help: Optional IP address used to localize results. Leave empty for default results.

id.label: Server name
id.help: Tool names start with mcp_<name>_. Letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only.

enabled.label: Enable server
enabled.help: After saving, connect to the server and register its tools. Turning it off disconnects and removes the tools.

command.label: Start command
command.help: One argument (argv) per line, not run through a shell.

env.label: Environment variables
env.help: A JSON object. Values whose names contain KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD, and similar are encrypted when saved. You can also write env:VARIABLE_NAME.

cwd.label: Working directory
cwd.placeholder: Leave empty to use the current directory

url.label: Server URL
url.help: The Streamable HTTP endpoint. Don't put a username or password in the URL.

headers.label: Request headers
headers.help: A JSON object. Every value is encrypted when saved. You can also write env:VARIABLE_NAME.

risk.label: Tool safety level
risk.help: The default level for all of this server's tools, which sets their default permissions. The server's own read-only hints aren't trusted.

tool_risks.label: Per-tool safety levels
tool_risks.help: Override the safety level by the MCP tool's original name.

disabled_tools.label: Hidden tools
disabled_tools.placeholder: One original MCP tool name per line
disabled_tools.help: These tools aren't offered to the model.
